gwalior-2014.notes: Source 5 has no copy in the pack, but the website crawl holds a file for that address (OnsiteProblem.pdf, 780572 bytes). The website's Important Dates page gives the site contest as 19 and 20 December 2014, the team list as 20 and 21 December, the problem set as 21 December. The crawl's OnsiteProblem.pdf (17 pages) is headed 'The 2013 ACM ASIA Region Programming Contest Kanpur Site', so it is of another edition.

sources.evidence: Home page of icpcgwalior.org titled ACM ICPC Gwalior Site 2014 says the site contest is over and links the 2014 result, problems and preliminary-round result PDFs.
Table of 89 rows with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Medal, Citation and Site citation under the title The 2014 ACM-ICPC Asia Gwalior Regional Contest.
3-page PDF headed Result of ACM ICPC Gwalior Site - 2014 with Rank, Team Name and Institute Name for ranks 1 to 8 and an alphabetical Honorable Mention list.
3-page PDF headed List (tentative) of Teams Selected through Preliminary Online Round for ACM ICPC Asia Region Gwalior Site 2014, numbered 1 to 89 plus a withheld seat.
27-page PDF titled The 2014 ACM ASIA Region Programming Contest Gwalior Site, Onsite Contest Problems, 21st December 2014, 12 Problems, with Problem A to Problem L.

gwalior-2017.notes: Website crawl is mostly spam; only seven files belong to icpc-iiitm.com as a contest site, two PDFs and two home pages are of the 2018 and 2019 editions. Source 3 is a generic CodeChef shell page.

sources.evidence: Three snapshots of the home page of icpc-iiitm.com dated December 2017 are titled ACM-ICPC Asia Gwalior Regionals 2017 and name ABV-IIITM Gwalior as host, but most of the 150 files are unrelated sale and streaming-spam pages.
Table of 93 rows with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time and Citation under the title The 2017 ACM-ICPC Asia Gwalior Regional Contest.
The copy is the CodeChef Contest Page shell with only the footer, roadmap and compiler links, and no contest, problem or result content.
